story.what_it_does: Caplin Point makes and sells generic medicines, with a growing injectables business and a US arm (Caplin Steriles) that holds regulated-market approvals. FY2025-26 consolidated revenue from operations was ₹2,187.19 crore, and the US was about 21% of revenue.
story.plans: The company plans about ₹1,000 crore of capex funded from internal accruals, including an oncology API facility due in Q4 FY27. It also plans to file 60+ products in non-US markets over the next 18 months and launch more US products.
story.moat: The notes show a debt-free balance sheet with ₹1,534 crore of free cash (Sep 2026) and EBITDA margins near 38%. It also has a growing list of US generic approvals (60 ANDAs approved in Q1 FY27), which is hard for new entrants to copy quickly.

scenarios.story: Revenue keeps growing at around 19-20% with margins near 38%, and new US launches and the planned doubling of CSU revenue and profit by FY27 add to growth. Capex is funded from cash, so the company stays debt-free.
signals_to_watch: H1 FY27 revenue growth of about 19% continuing in later quarters
US segment revenue growing from ₹264.01 crore in H1 FY27
